subject: Television & Streaming
title: Elaine Benes: The Woman in the Boys' Club
description: Learn Elaine Benes: The Woman in the Boys' Club in one minute.

hook.text: Elaine Benes was as petty, selfish, and neurotic as Jerry, George, and Kramer.

buildup.text: Julia Louis-Dreyfus played Elaine with physical comedy that rivaled anyone on the show.

discovery.text: Elaine wasn't the voice of reason or the love interest.

twist.text: Network executives initially wanted Seinfeld to have no female regulars.

climax.text: Elaine Benes shattered the expectation that women in sitcoms must be sensible.

punchline.text: The best female character in comedy was the least well-behaved.

quiz.question: How did Elaine Benes break sitcom conventions for female characters?
options: She was equally petty and selfish as the male characters, not the voice of reason
